# Add local repo as a source
exec axen source add ./local-repo

# Test default bundle auto-install
# Running without skills or bundles should install skill2 automatically due to default bundle
exec axen install local-repo -t claude
stdout 'Auto-installing default bundle'
stdout 'skill2'
! stdout 'skill1'

# Test bundle flag
# Should install only skill1 since we pass frontend bundle
exec axen install local-repo -b frontend -t claude
stdout 'skill1'
! stdout 'skill2'

# Test invalid bundle warning
exec axen install local-repo -b unknown_bundle -t claude
stdout 'Bundle .unknown_bundle. not found in manifest'

-- local-repo/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "local-repo", "skills": {"skill1": {"path": "."}, "skill2": {"path": "."}}, "bundles": {"frontend": {"skills": ["skill1"]}, "default": {"is_default": true, "skills": ["skill2"]}}}
-- local-repo/SKILL.md --
# Skill
